_comment: ice: Map 4, an ice cavern (pass 4: upright cylinder wall, smooth dome, no icicles), one sculpt exported as four chunks (ice_build.py writes ice.chunks.json, which carries each chunk's own node_paths): ice_ground.glb (IceGround: pit floor, pit wall and its cells, crevassed rim, lane), ice_wall.glb (IceWall: upright cylinder of cut ice with tiers of barred cell rooms, lane edge to the spring line), ice_gate.glb (IceGate: the slotted ice screen across the lane at 353 deg) and ice_roof.glb (IceRoof: the smooth see-through dome, COLOR_0 rgba; IceRoofOuter: the bright shell seen through it). Each chunk ships its own `-colonly` collider. World coordinates, instanced at identity. Notes in docs/maps/ice.md.
